content:
设
\[
L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}\left[\frac{x^n}{(x-1)(x-2)\cdots(x-n)}\right]^x
\]

取对数：
\[
\ln L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}x\ln\frac{x^n}{\prod_{k=1}^n(x-k)}
\]

因为
\[
\frac{x^n}{\prod_{k=1}^n(x-k)}
=\frac{1}{\prod_{k=1}^n\left(1-\frac{k}{x}\right)}
\]

当 \(x\to+\infty\) 时，
\[
\prod_{k=1}^n\left(1-\frac{k}{x}\right)
=1-\frac{1+2+\cdots+n}{x}+O\left(\frac1{x^2}\right)
=1-\frac{n(n+1)}{2x}+O\left(\frac1{x^2}\right)
\]

所以
\[
\frac{x^n}{\prod_{k=1}^n(x-k)}
=1+\frac{n(n+1)}{2x}+O\left(\frac1{x^2}\right)
\]

于是
\[
\ln\frac{x^n}{\prod_{k=1}^n(x-k)}
=\frac{n(n+1)}{2x}+O\left(\frac1{x^2}\right)
\]

因此
\[
\ln L=\lim_{x\to+\infty}x\left[\frac{n(n+1)}{2x}+O\left(\frac1{x^2}\right)\right]
=\frac{n(n+1)}{2}
\]

所以
\[
L=e^{\frac{n(n+1)}{2}}
\]

答案：C
